name: The Lippincott Team
intro: Led by Amy Lippincott, the team handles buying, selling, rentals and relocation across Northwest Houston. Recent HAR comments recommend the team for Cypress and Bridgeland and name individual team members, including J-R Satchel and Janet. That team structure can cover different tasks; ask who will manage your day-to-day communication and whether Amy will take part directly.
short: Buying, selling, rentals and relocation across Northwest Houston. Recent HAR comments name team members, so ask who will lead your file.

name: Kevan Pewitt
intro: Kevan Pewitt is the broker-owner of Houston Prime Realty. His recent site articles explain Cypress property taxes and MUDs for buyers and outline seller marketing choices. An October 1 HAR buyer comment praises his notes on homes and neighborhoods and his effort to find the right location and deal. His service area reaches across Greater Houston, Cypress and Katy to Bryan–College Station, so ask how often he works in your target Cypress neighborhood.
short: Appraisal and finance background, with detailed Cypress guidance on property taxes and MUDs. His wider service area makes neighborhood-specific experience a good question.

facts.text: His official biography identifies him as the broker-owner of Houston Prime Realty and describes service across Greater Houston, including Cypress, Katy and Bryan–College Station.
His biography lists the Certified Residential Specialist designation, a Texas residential appraisal background and a BBA in finance.
The newest visible HAR comment, dated October 1, 2026, praises detailed property notes, fit with the buyer’s location needs and negotiation.
HAR lists his brokerage as Houston Prime Realty and publishes his professional profile and transaction activity.
A buyer comment on HAR dated October 1, 2026 says Kevan took notes on the homes and areas they considered and worked to find a location that fit them and the best deal.

A 2026 Cypress guide on his website discusses property taxes and municipal utility districts, useful topics for buyers comparing neighborhood costs. The details still need checking for a specific address.
His seller guide describes listing preparation and marketing, and says sellers can discuss buyer-agent compensation contributions before choosing a plan.

name: Michele Harmon
intro: Michele Harmon leads a RE/MAX Universal team serving Cypress and nearby Northwest Houston communities. HAR lists her Certified Negotiation Expert credential. Her recent Cypress transaction record includes buyer representation on a country home/acreage listing and seller representation on a detached home, so the visible record covers both sides and more than one property type. The reviewed HAR profile showed no verified Client Experience Rating or recent written comment; ask for current references and who would lead your transaction.
short: CNE team lead with recent Cypress buyer and seller activity, including a country home/acreage listing. HAR feedback is sparse in this snapshot; ask for current references.

name: Jill Smith
intro: Jill Smith leads a Cypress-focused team. Her October 6, 2026 seller guide says she builds a price recommendation from closed sales in the home’s subdivision, then accounts for condition, lot, upgrades, active listings and nearby new construction. A September HAR seller comment calls the process straightforward. HAR lists 11 agents and separate listing, transaction and marketing coordinators, so ask who would handle each stage and remain your main contact.
short: Cypress seller pricing based on subdivision sales, home condition and new-build competition. Her team lists 11 agents and separate coordinators; confirm your day-to-day lead.

facts.text: HAR lists Copper Lakes, Copperfield, Towne Lake, Stone Gate and Riata Ranch among the Cypress-area communities in her biography.
Her HAR profile lists negotiation, buyer and seller credentials including MCNE, ABR and CRS.

A seller comment dated September 16, 2026 describes the process as straightforward. The 4.91/5 score across 548 completed surveys is attributed to Jill individually, not the whole team or Cypress-only transactions.
Her official website presents the Jill Smith Team; confirm who would handle your day-to-day communication.
In an October 6, 2026 article, Jill says she prices Cypress homes against recent sales in the same subdivision, property condition, lot, upgrades, current competition and nearby new construction.

HAR lists 11 active team agents plus listing, transaction and marketing coordinators. The listing coordinator manages the listing through contract, then a transaction coordinator manages the file through closing. Ask who will handle decisions and updates.

name: Collette King
intro: Collette King leads a RE/MAX Universal team serving Cypress and a wider Houston area. HAR lists more than 27 years in real estate and recent buyer, seller and rental activity. The team’s seller testimonials describe advice on pre-listing work, contractor coordination for an out-of-state seller and help selecting offers in Bridgeland. Those testimonials are self-published and undated. HAR shows no verified Client Experience Rating, and its visible written recommendation dates to February 2020, so ask for current references and the name of your day-to-day contact.
short: Long experience and seller guidance on preparation, contractors and offers. The team’s testimonials are undated, and HAR feedback is limited; request a recent reference.
